About the Role

We are looking for a talented Full Stack Developer to join our growing technology team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications using modern front-end and back-end technologies. You’ll work closely with designers, product managers, and other developers to deliver high-quality software solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Develop, test, and deploy responsive web applications across the full stack.

Collaborate with UI/UX designers to translate wireframes and mockups into functional code.

Build and maintain RESTful or GraphQL APIs and integrate them with front-end applications.

Optimize applications for performance, scalability, and reliability.

Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following best practices.

Participate in code reviews, debugging, and troubleshooting issues.

Stay up to date with emerging technologies and recommend improvements.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Product, QA, DevOps) to ensure timely project delivery.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).

2–5 years of experience as a Full Stack Developer or similar role.

Strong proficiency in front-end technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), and frameworks like React.js, Vue.js, or Angular.

Hands-on experience with back-end technologies such as Node.js, Express.js, Python (Django/Flask), or Java (Spring Boot).

Experience working with databases (SQL – MySQL/PostgreSQL; NoSQL – MongoDB, Redis).

Knowledge of version control systems (Git, GitHub, GitLab).

Familiarity with cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP) and CI/CD pipelines is a plus.

Understanding of containerization tools such as Docker and Kubernetes is an advantage.

Soft Skills

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

Self-motivated and eager to learn new technologies.

Ability to manage time effectively and work in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with TypeScript or Next.js/Nest.js.

Exposure to microservices architecture.

Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies.

Benefits

Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.

Health insurance and paid time off.

Learning & development opportunities.

Flexible working hours and hybrid/remote options.
